map.为什么我输入的内容没进去？: Why didn't my typed text go in?
map.多半是没进插入模式：Vim 启动后处于普通模式，直接打字会被当作命令。按 i 进: Probably you weren't in insert mode: after launch Vim is in normal mode, and typing is treated as commands. Press i to enter insert mode, type, then Esc to return to normal mode and enter :wq to save and quit. Also :q! forcibly discards changes — save with :w first when unsure.

p  paste after the cursor

map.分类列表以「全部」开头，再按命令出现顺序把未收录的分类去重追加。过滤：所选分类非: The category list starts with "All", then appends categories not yet included, deduplicated, in command order. Filtering: when the selected category is not "All" the command's category must be equal; when the keyword is non-empty, the command, description, category, parameters, example, and syntax fields are concatenated, lowercased, and must contain the keyword. The hit count updates in real time as "N items total"
